unlisted_practices: Collect data that accurately reflects the variety of diseases and the diversity of the population when implementing digital twin technology in clinical care.
Establish consistent data collection protocols and standardization for digital twin data through collaboration among researchers, clinicians, data scientists, and policymakers.
Validate digital twin model predictions against outcomes of previously treated, closely matched patients.
